infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Only for a remote model service you set up at an address on your local network or Tailscale. 仅用于你在局域网或 Tailscale 地址上设置的远程模型服务。
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VoxtMini records your voice while you use its shortcut and recognises it on this Mac, unless you choose a remote speech service for a feature: then that feature's recordings go to the service. 录音只在你使用快捷键时进行，默认在这台 Mac 上识别；只有你为某个功能选了远程语音服务，该功能的录音才会发给这个服务。
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: With Apple Speech chosen, macOS recognises your recordings on this Mac only: the audio never leaves it. 选用 Apple 语音识别时，由 macOS 只在这台 Mac 上识别你的录音：音频不会离开这台 Mac。
